transcript:
Patient Bot: Hello. I'd like to become a new patient at your practice and schedule my 1st appointment.
PGAI Agent: The Point Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Sarah?
Patient Bot: Hi. Thanks for calling The Point Orthopaedics. Hi, No. This is Kevin Martinez. I'm calling to schedule a new patient appointment. Could you help me with that?
PGAI Agent: I can help with scheduling. Are you calling to book this appointment for yourself? Or for someone else?
Patient Bot: Great. Yes. That's right. It's for me. Name is Kevin Martine.
PGAI Agent: Please provide your date of birth.
Patient Bot: Sure. It's August 30th 19 88.
PGAI Agent: Just to confirm, I have your name as Kevin Martinez and your date of birth as August 30th 19 88. Is that correct? If so, could you please spell your 1st and last name for me?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's correct. My 1st name is spelled k e v I n, and my last name is m a r t I n e z.
PGAI Agent: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please provide the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?
Patient Bot: Uh, I don't think I've been to your office before. So I probably don't have a number on file yet.
PGAI Agent: No problem. Let's confirm your information 1 more time. Please spell your 1st and last name and confirm your date of birth.
Patient Bot: Thanks.
Patient Bot: Sure thing. My 1st name is k e v I n. Last name, m a r t I n e z. My date of birth is August 30th. 19 88.
PGAI Agent: I have your phone number as 2 1 9 2 8 5 7 6 0 9.
Patient Bot: Oh, actually
PGAI Agent: And your date of birth is August
Patient Bot: actually, I haven't given my phone number yet.
PGAI Agent: Go ahead. Please let me know if there's an update to your phone number or any other information. Take your time. Please let me know if you need to update your phone number or any other details.
Patient Bot: Oh, sorry about that. My phone number is 2 1 9 2 8 5 5 7 6 0 9, and I think everything else is correct.
PGAI Agent: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Please hold while I connect you to our patient support team. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait. Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line.
Patient Bot: Okay.
PGAI Agent: Goodbye.
Patient Bot: Alright. Thank you for your help. I appreciate it. Have a great day. Goodbye.
summary: Kevin Martinez called The Point Orthopaedics to schedule a new patient appointment for himself. He provided his name, date of birth, and phone number, clarifying that he was a new patient. The agent was unable to complete the scheduling process and transferred him to the patient support team.
